name: Numata (Gunma, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Numata city emblem in white: a broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Numata, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 4 January 2002; the emblem dates from 1 April 1965.

features.role: Numata city emblem — a broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a cross
